hook: Water crunch may peak in *March-April 2027*, expert warns
hook_b: Water crunch may peak in *March-April 2027*, expert warns
tldr: With kharif crops failed under El Niño, IIT-Gandhinagar's Vimal Mishra warns effects could last until the next monsoon, with scarcity sharpest in March and April 2027.

beats.what: Vimal Mishra, Dean (R&D), IIT-Gandhinagar, said governments must assess reservoir and groundwater stocks against domestic and farm needs.
beats.why: Rising temperatures in coming months could raise irrigation needs, pressuring reservoirs and groundwater.
beats.care: Experts quoted urge putting drinking water, hospitals and schools first if supplies run short.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Mishra advised that irrigation-intensive crops may not be advisable this rabi season in affected regions.

cards.q: Have you noticed water supply cuts where you live this month?

qs: How much water do Hyderabad's reservoirs hold for summer?
Which crops would farmers switch to in rabi?

facts.t: Farmers on one Kalwakurthy branch canal cut paddy to *10,000-15,000 acres* from a usual 20,000-30,000, a farmer estimated.
The Union Agriculture Minister put India's rainfall deficit at about *12%*.

steps.e: El Niño effects may last until then

viz.verdict: Water stress is expected to worsen before it eases.

watch: Water budgeting by the State before summer, and whether rabi sowing shifts away from water-heavy crops.
fact: Telangana's water scarcity may be worst in *March-April 2027*, an IIT-Gandhinagar expert warns
twist: He estimates *67%* of Telangana is drought-affected and calls this El Niño the strongest ever.
